book.name: Iba
book.title: Iba ngwi a kye tso iJɔn

content: Ani di ambɛ oka okwulewo kpakpa mi esho; engyesɔ nghi egyafa yi isɔ egyafa emi olɛlɛ, ikyekyɛ yi isɔ ntonɛ itingga mgbi Imgbasho ngyɛ.

Ani di di ungwɔ ndzɛ dafi onekyoo idzinggi ngwuo yi ola, mi ele ma inggisɛ ama nngha mmbwaba na ika bɛyi adagyɛ mgban yi isɔ mgbi iyi mgban ma kwudzɛ to ele. Ali inggisɛ mgbi ama byi ozuna ngwi Imgbasho gbe nu ma mani
di shashi mgbi iMose ongbidɔ mgbi Imgbasho bɛyi ashi mgbi Ongwummala gbɛɛ:

content.text: Ofɛ mgbi abu li otsitsi yi oyɛyɛ,
Li emɛ ka tsio abu ba, Otsɛ,
di kye mmwɛ nu mi iyi mgbi abu ba?
Lubana li abu yuo le saan.
ikyesinɛ ali mgbi abu osaan tsotɔ wa.>>

content: Ngwi ungwɔ ntonɛ nyɛ nɛ, ani di a kye kwulu ozu okwukwo osunu Imgbasho mi esho bɛyi iTabenako Obwɛndɛ nani.
Mi ozu okwukwo osunu Imgbasho na, engyesɔ egyafa tɔ yi isɔ nghi egyafa. A wo angwuto ondlɛndlɛ gbosinɛ kwɔ yi okpa abashi bwato igɛgɛ mgbi ama.
Nɛ onyi mbi atta owamyɛ nghi enɛ ntona kye uga abashi egyafa nu engyesɔ egyafa ntona yi itingga mgbi Imgbasho mi ele kyɛɛ, Imgbasho ndzɛ oshishe gyegwu nɛni.
Nɛ iwu mi okwɔkwɔ bɛyi mfye mgbi Imgbasho gbɛ ozu na sɔ man inggisɛ onyi kaka ele wuba nghataa isɔ egyafa mgbi engyesɔ egyafa ntona mbwumbwo.
